content.title: Chapter 82 - PURCHASING AND CONTRACTS — Sec. 82-5. - Administrative policies and procedures.
content.summary:
The city manager may, with assistance from the finance director, develop or amend
               and promulgate under
section 2-121
of this Code administrative policies and procedures necessary to implement the city's
               purchasing and contracts processes.
(Ord. No.
4774
, § 1, 8-16-2021…
